title: Gutter Cleaning Work Order
subtitle: Residential Gutter Cleaning: connects authorized scope to results.
description: Gutter Cleaning Work Order covers gutter run, outlet, downspout, discharge, roof edge, and collected debris. The gutter service coordinator records Residential Gutter Cleaning authorized tasks, materials, results, and changes. Gutter Cleaning Work Order keeps Residential Gutter Cleaning exceptions visible until the gutter service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Gutter Cleaning Work Order at residence perimeter, roof edge, ladder position, discharge point, and protected landscaping. Document gutter run, outlet, downspout, discharge, roof edge, and collected debris identity before Residential Gutter Cleaning begins. Compare gutter run, outlet, downspout, discharge, roof edge, and collected debris findings with stated Residential Gutter Cleaning criteria; route unresolved Residential Gutter Cleaning issues to exterior service supervisor. For Gutter Cleaning Work Order, confirm requirements for Residential Gutter Cleaning. Ask exterior service supervisor to review Residential Gutter Cleaning conditions beyond the gutter service coordinator's role.

sections.title: Work authorization and responsible parties
sections.guidance: For Residential Gutter Cleaning, identify responsible parties, residence perimeter, roof edge, ladder position, discharge point, and protected landscaping, and the linked gutter run, outlet, downspout, discharge, roof edge, and collected debris source.

fields.label: Access method, roof height, weather, and discharge expectation

sections.title: Work-order tasks, resources, and results
sections.guidance: Capture Residential Gutter Cleaning facts for gutter run, outlet, downspout, discharge, roof edge, and collected debris; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Residential Gutter Cleaning authorized-work checks
items: Gutter pitch, joint, hanger, seam, and visible damage
Discharge location, erosion, and foundation proximity
Roof-edge, fascia, soffit, and adjacent condition

sections.title: Scope exception, work status, and handoff
sections.guidance: Resolve open Residential Gutter Cleaning conditions; have gutter service coordinator assign the next Residential Gutter Cleaning owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Scope changes, holds, and retained evidence
items: Unsafe ladder, edge, weather, or power-line proximity
Loose gutter or damaged fascia cannot support work
Downspout blockage requires disassembly beyond scope
Water discharge creates property or erosion concern
blocks.guidance: Pause Residential Gutter Cleaning when access, edge, weather, electrical proximity, unstable attachment, or unsafe discharge remains. Retain the available Residential Gutter Cleaning proof and route unresolved gutter run, outlet, downspout, discharge, roof edge, and collected debris scope to gutter service coordinator.
